packageRules.description: @tauri-apps/api, @tauri-apps/cli and the tauri crate move together: `tauri build` refuses an api whose minor differs from the cli's or the crate's (every Bragi release from v2026.7.5 until the three were matched). One group, one pull request; the pins in package.json and Cargo.lock stay in step.
The copier template source in .copier-answers.yml has no Renovate datasource; it moves with a converge, never with Renovate.

package.json's packageManager pin must equal the pnpm nixpkgs ships: flake.nix's sandboxed build installs with that pnpm, and a newer pin makes pnpm try to fetch itself and die with no HOME. Renovate can move only one side, so this pin moves by hand with the nixpkgs input.
